body.name: \(\mathfrak B(\Xi)\)
body.construction: Count one primitive operation for each exact rational addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, comparison, dyadic floor or ceiling, and integer-table update; an interval operation counts all of its endpoint primitives, and fixed-order fraction-free elimination, \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\), and matrix solves are expanded into these primitives. Put \(h_\star=a_{\mathrm{TM}}+3\), \(m_\star=pq_\star^p\{s_{\mathrm{tail}}+h_\star(q_\star+1)+2\}\), \(A_\star=\binom{d_\star+h_\star}{h_\star}\), \(C_{\mathrm{rec}}=4096(J+K)(L^2+L)S_R(d_\star+1)^2A_\star^2(m_\star+1)^{2p}\), \(N_{\mathrm{leaf}}=G_{\#}2^{c_{\max}}+G_{\#}2^{b_{\max}}+(G_{\#}+\binom{G_{\#}}2)4^{b_{\max}}+1\), and \(P_{\mathrm{ar}}=1+\lceil(b_{\mathrm{cap}}-b_0)/\Delta b\rceil\). The moment calls in the tail recursion have order at most \(m_\star\); their ancestor trees, Bell tables, retained-state Poisson recurrences through order \(a_{\mathrm{TM}}+1\), Taylor coefficients, grid products, and first two contrast derivatives use at most \(C_{\mathrm{rec}}\) primitives per leaf. The deterministic rank, chart, Krawczyk, \(LDL^{\mathsf T}\), covariance, and sandwich routines use at most \(256(J+K+d_\star+KL)^3\) further primitives per leaf. Define \(\mathfrak B(\Xi)=P_{\mathrm{ar}}N_{\mathrm{leaf}}\{C_{\mathrm{rec}}+256(J+K+d_\star+KL)^3\}\). The displayed loop bounds and the fixed recurrence orders therefore give this literal finite ceiling on every counted operation, including unsuccessful precision passes; the bound is deliberately coarse and makes no polynomial-time claim.
